messages:
Maya Li: quick thing — we need to pick how console + routing handle v1->v2 for signed-billing tokens. do we auto-route (silent) or show per-tenant cost/latency preview and require opt-in?

Tom B: high level: silent auto-route is friendlier but risky for billing shock. customers keep asking for a preview first.

Rachel C: agree with Tom. Also telemetry is noisy for handshake misses right now — our sampling drops some tenant edgecases, so previews could be inaccurate.

Kyle O: to add — v2 changes tokenization slightly for a subset of models; cost delta is not uniform. we should sample by recent requests per-tenant and show an estimated delta with a confidence band.

Maya Li: proposal: console shows "Migration Impact Preview" that runs a 24h sample on the tenant's recent traffic and estimates tokens/latency/cost delta. default routing remains v1 until tenant explicitly toggles to v2. also add a small canary route (1%) for early opt-ins.

product-jane: product + legal: customers want clarity about invoice changes. preview must show estimated monthly delta and highlight that it's an estimate. also need a checkbox acknowledging billing change before enabling auto-switch.

Tom B: engineering questions — how expensive is running the preview sampling? can we reuse existing telemetry export?

Rachel C: we can compute estimates offline using existing traces in ClickHouse; main gap is missing header for API version in some proxies — we drop X-Api-Version for some old SDKs so mapping is fuzzy. need to backfill heuristics: look at Accept header and client-agent.

Kyle O: sketch of heuristic query (psuedo):
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as reqs, avg(seq_len) as mean_seq, p50_latency
FROM requests
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
AND client_agent NOT LIKE '%internal-proxy%'
GROUP BY tenant_id
```
Use that to simulate token counts for v2 models.

Maya Li: UX question — do we surface "estimated cost increase" as absolute dollars or percent? both?

product-jane: show both. percent is easier to scan, dollars are mandatory for invoicing context. add "confidence" (high/med/low) based on sample size.

Tom B: routing fallback: if tenant toggles to v2 and we see a 10% latency regression we should auto-fallback to v1 for 24h and alert the tenant + SE. need runbook.

Rachel C: also telemetry: add a new metric "migration_preview_sample_size" per-tenant and emit to datadog. we should include a tag "heuristic_applied" when X-Api-Version header missing.

Kyle O: about quotas — if v2 is costlier for same tokens, do we map quota units 1:1? or expose a "billing-adjusted quota" in console?

product-jane: customers will expect quota to be consistent. propose: keep quota units 1:1 initially, but warn in preview if billing > quota implications. longer term expose adjustable quota with admin controls.

Maya Li: security note — signed-billing tokens are also used to route to dedicated pools (tenant isolation). any routing change must preserve the signed-token semantics. ops-bot: any infra constraints?

ops-bot: infra: Canary routing config rollout triggered: canary-v2-routing v1->v2 at 1% for tenants on the opt-in list. No infra blockers for preview compute; be mindful of ClickHouse query cost when running wide previews.

Tom B: ok next steps: 1) Rachel to produce telemetry delta plan (headers, sample-size metric, datadog alerts) 2) Kyle to prototype preview simulation script and cost estimator 3) Maya + product-jane to draft console copy + confirmation flow 4) Ops to run a dry-run canary to validate fallback runbook.

Rachel C: will do. quick FYI: there's a backlog task to normalize Accept header parsing — I'll bump priority.

Kyle O: I'll prototype a lambda that replays N recent requests through v2 tokenizer to estimate token delta. low-perf but good enough for preview.

product-jane: copy draft: "Estimated changes if you switch to v2: +7% tokens (~$12/mo), latency +20ms. Confidence: medium. This is an estimate based on a 7-day sample. " will refine.

Maya Li: perfect. let's sync on runbook Thurs. thanks everyone :pray:
